mapper.select: SELECT layer_id,policy::text AS policy_json,policy_version,published_build_id FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization WHERE layer_id=#{layerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization(layer_id,policy) VALUES(#{layerId},CAST(#{policy} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(layer_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization SET policy=CAST(#{policy} AS jsonb),policy_version=policy_version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id=#{layerId} AND policy_version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b WHERE b.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b WHERE layer_id=#{layerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build(id,layer_id,data_version,policy_version,policy) SELECT #{id},l.id,l.data_version,c.policy_version,c.policy FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization c ON c.layer_id=l.id WHERE l.id=#{layerId} AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' AND (c.policy->>'enabled')::boolean ON CONFLICT(layer_id) WHERE build_status='QUEUED' DO UPDATE SET data_version=EXCLUDED.data_version,policy_version=EXCLUDED.policy_version,policy=EXCLUDED.policy
mapper.select: SELECT b.id FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=b.layer_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE b.build_status='QUEUED' OR (b.build_status='RUNNING' AND b.lease_expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY b.create_time,b.id LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b SET build_status='RUNNING',attempt=attempt+1, completed_zoom=-1,lease_expires_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '5 minutes',error_message=NULL,finish_time=NULL WHERE b.id=(SELECT id FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build WHERE id=#{id} AND (build_status='QUEUED' OR (build_status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING b.*,b.policy::text AS policy_json
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build SET completed_zoom=#{zoom},lease_expires_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '5 minutes' WHERE id=#{id} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND build_status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization c SET published_build_id=b.id,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=b.layer_id WHERE c.layer_id=#{layerId} AND b.id=#{id} AND b.layer_id=c.layer_id AND b.build_status='READY' AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' AND l.data_version=b.data_version AND c.policy_version=b.policy_version AND (c.policy->>'enabled')::boolean
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_feature WHERE build_id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization WHERE published_build_id=#{id})

DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_feature f USING ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization_build b WHERE f.build_id=b.id AND b.layer_id=#{layerId} AND b.build_status IN ('READY','FAILED','SUPERSEDED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalization c WHERE c.published_build_id=b.id)
DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_feature WHERE build_id=#{id} AND zoom=#{z}
mapper.sql: SELECT f.id,d.geom,f.properties FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_Dump(ST_Force2D(f.geom)) d WHERE f.layer_id=#{layerId} AND f.deleted=0 AND ST_Dimension(d.geom)>0
mapper.select: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f WHERE f.layer_id=#{layerId} AND f.deleted=0 AND octet_length(COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,f.properties->k) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{fieldsJson} AS jsonb)) k WHERE jsonb_exists(f.properties,k)),'{}'::jsonb)::text)>4096)

WITH source AS (), edges AS ( SELECT ST_CoverageInvalidEdges(ST_Transform(geom,3857)) OVER() AS edge FROM source WHERE ST_Dimension(geom)=2) SELECT COALESCE(bool_and(edge IS NULL OR ST_IsEmpty(edge)),true) FROM edges

SELECT ST_XMin(g) AS west,ST_YMin(g) AS south,ST_XMax(g) AS east,ST_YMax(g) AS north FROM (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Intersection(geographic_extent, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-85.0511287798066,180,85.0511287798066,4326)),3857) AS g FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE id=#{layerId} AND geographic_extent IS NOT NULL) s WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g)
mapper.insert:
WITH settings AS (SELECT CAST(#{policy} AS jsonb) AS p,40075016.68557849/(256*power(2.0,#{z})) AS res), source AS MATERIALIZED (), projected AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s.id,ST_Dimension(s.geom) AS dim, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,s.properties->k) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->'groupFields') k WHERE jsonb_exists(s.properties,k)),'{}'::jsonb) AS props, ST_Transform(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(s.geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-85.0511287798066,180,85.0511287798066,4326)),ST_Dimension(s.geom)+1),3857) AS geom FROM source s CROSS JOIN settings WHERE ST_Dimension(s.geom)!=1 OR #{z}>=COALESCE((p->'lineMinZoom'->>(s.properties->>(p->>'lineClassField')))::int, (p->>'defaultLineMinZoom')::int) ), processed AS ( SELECT id,dim,props,ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(geom,res*(p->>'tolerancePixels')::double precision*#{factor}) AS geom FROM projected CROSS JOIN settings WHERE dim=1 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) UNION ALL SELECT id,dim,props,
ST_CoverageSimplify(geom,res*(p->>'tolerancePixels')::double precision*#{factor}) OVER()
ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(geom,res*(p->>'tolerancePixels')::double precision*#{factor})
FROM projected CROSS JOIN settings WHERE dim=2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND (p->>'polygonMode' IN ('BUILDINGS','COVERAGE') OR ST_Area(geom)>=res*res*(p->>'minPolygonPixels')::double precision) ), located AS ( SELECT *,CASE WHEN dim=2 AND p->>'polygonMode'='BUILDINGS' AND #{z}<=8 THEN res*8 ELSE res*(p->>'cellPixels')::int*#{factor} END AS cell_size FROM processed CROSS JOIN settings ), bucketed AS ( SELECT *,floor((ST_X(ST_PointOnSurface(geom))+20037508.342789244)/cell_size)::bigint AS cx, floor((ST_Y(ST_PointOnSurface(geom))+20037508.342789244)/cell_size)::bigint AS cy, CASE WHEN dim=2 AND p->>'polygonMode'='COVERAGE' THEN id::text ELSE '' END AS identity_key FROM located WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) ), grouped AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT dim,props,cx,cy,identity_key,cell_size,array_agg(DISTINCT id) AS ids, ST_Collect(geom) AS geom FROM bucketed GROUP BY dim,props,cx,cy,identity_key,cell_size ), shapes AS ( SELECT md5(dim::text||':'||props::text||':'||cx||':'||cy||':'||identity_key) AS rid, CASE WHEN dim=1 THEN 'LINE' ELSE 'POLYGON' END AS category,props,ids, CASE WHEN dim=1 THEN ST_LineMerge(geom) WHEN p->>'polygonMode'='COVERAGE' THEN geom WHEN p->>'polygonMode'='BUILDINGS' AND #{z}<=8 THEN ST_MakeEnvelope(cx*cell_size-20037508.342789244,cy*cell_size-20037508.342789244, (cx+1)*cell_size-20037508.342789244,(cy+1)*cell_size-20037508.342789244,3857) WHEN p->>'polygonMode'='BUILDINGS' THEN ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology( ST_Buffer(ST_UnaryUnion(ST_Buffer(geom,res*(p->>'aggregationPixels')::double precision/2)), -res*(p->>'aggregationPixels')::double precision/2),res*(p->>'tolerancePixels')::double precision*#{factor}) ELSE ST_UnaryUnion(geom) END AS geom FROM grouped CROSS JOIN settings ), stored AS ( INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_feature(build_id,zoom,representation_id,category,properties,geom,feature_count) SELECT #{id},#{z},rid,category,props,geom,cardinality(ids) FROM shapes WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) RETURNING representation_id ) INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_member(build_id,zoom,representation_id,feature_id) SELECT #{id},#{z},s.rid,m FROM shapes s JOIN stored t ON t.representation_id=s.rid CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.ids) m
mapper.select: , shapes AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN point_count>1 THEN 'cluster' ELSE 'feature' END AS "_vector_kind", CASE WHEN point_count=1 THEN feature_id::text END AS "_vector_feature_id", CASE WHEN point_count=1 THEN geometry_path END AS "_vector_geometry_path", CASE WHEN point_count>1 THEN cluster_id END AS "_vector_cluster_id",NULL::text AS "_vector_representation_id", 'POINT'::text AS "_vector_category",props::text AS "_vector_properties", point_count::text AS "_vector_count",feature_count::text AS "_vector_feature_count",geom FROM point_shapes UNION ALL SELECT 'aggregate',NULL,NULL,NULL,#{z}::text||':'||f.representation_id,f.category, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k,f.properties->k) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{fieldsJson} AS jsonb)) k WHERE jsonb_exists(f.properties,k)),'{}'::jsonb)::text,NULL,f.feature_count::text,f.geom FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_generalized_feature f CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE f.build_id=#{buildId} AND f.zoom=#{z} AND f.geom && b.query_box ), clipped AS ( SELECT s.*,m.tile_geom FROM shapes s CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(s.geom,b.tile_box,4096,#{bufferPixels}*16,true) AS tile_geom OFFSET 0) m ), encoded AS ( SELECT "_vector_kind","_vector_feature_id","_vector_geometry_path","_vector_cluster_id","_vector_representation_id", "_vector_category","_vector_properties","_vector_count","_vector_feature_count",tile_geom AS geom FROM clipped WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(tile_geom) AND ST_GeometryType(tile_geom)!='ST_GeometryCollection' AND ST_Dimension(tile_geom)=CASE "_vector_category" WHEN 'POINT' THEN 0 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ), tile AS (SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',4096,'geom'),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body)<=#{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
